description:
Point-in-time fundamentals for `ticker` as known on `as_of_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
Returns each available metric's value for the fiscal period with source + knowledge time +
lineage under `metrics`. Any requested metric with no value appears under `unavailable` with
`{reason, code, available_alternatives, docs_url}` instead of being silently dropped. `code` is
`not_reported` or `financials_family`. `revenue` keeps the headline tag first filed for that
period (including `RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense` for brokers and card issuers) and follows
that tag's own restatements. A later tag does not replace it, and components are not summed.
A financial with only component lines gets `financials_family` and the populated members.
Check `unavailable` before concluding a figure does not exist.
name: get_fundamentals
title: Get point-in-time fundamentals
